plugins.description: Sixteen Claude skills for crypto day trading: a scout that lists today's setups with their backtest records, a chart scanner, a coin report, a derivatives radar, a news monitor, whale watch, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 outcomes, a budget manager, a liquidation guard, a risk manager, an order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), alerts, a trading journal and a setup doctor.
